statement:
theorem fractionFieldTower_of_common_integral_base
    {A : Type uA} {C : Type uB} {F : Type uF} {KC : Type uF'}
    {P : Type uP}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Algebra A C]
    [Field F] [Algebra A F] [IsFractionRing A F]
    [Field KC] [Algebra C KC] [IsFractionRing C KC]
    [Algebra A KC] [IsScalarTower A C KC]
    [Algebra F KC] [IsScalarTower A F KC]
    [Field P] [Algebra A P] [Algebra C P] [IsScalarTower A C P]
    [Algebra F P] [IsScalarTower A F P]
    [Algebra KC P] [IsScalarTower C KC P] :
    IsScalarTower F KC P
proof:
:= by
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
  intro x
  have hmaps :
      (algebraMap KC P).comp (algebraMap F KC) = algebraMap F P := by
    apply IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext (A := A)
    intro a
    calc
      algebraMap KC P (algebraMap F KC (algebraMap A F a)) =
          algebraMap KC P (algebraMap A KC a) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A F KC]
      _ = algebraMap KC P (algebraMap C KC (algebraMap A C a)) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C KC]
      _ = algebraMap C P (algebraMap A C a) :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply C KC P _).symm
      _ = algebraMap A P a :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C P a).symm
      _ = algebraMap F P (algebraMap A F a) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A F P a
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun hmaps x).symm

    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.exists_prime_character_finite
statement:
theorem exists_prime_character_finite
    {A : Type*} [CommGroup A] [Finite A]
    (hA : ∀ a : A, a ^ q = 1) {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 1) :
    ∃ χ : A →* Multiplicative (ZMod q), χ x ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ι, instι, m, hm, ⟨e⟩⟩ := CommGroup.equiv_prod_multiplicative_zmod_of_finite A
  have hcoord : ∃ i : ι, e x i ≠ 1 := by
    by_contra! h
    apply hx
    apply e.injective
    rw [map_one]
    exact funext h
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcoord
  let ψ : A →* Multiplicative (ZMod (m i)) :=
    (Pi.evalMonoidHom (fun j : ι => Multiplicative (ZMod (m j))) i).comp e.toMonoidHom
  have hψ : Function.Surjective ψ := by
    intro a
    refine ⟨e.symm (Function.update 1 i a), ?_⟩
    change e (e.symm (Function.update 1 i a)) i = a
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply, Function.update_self]
  have hmdiv : m i ∣ q := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hψ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod (m i)))
    have hp : (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod (m i))) ^ q = 1 := by
      rw [← ha, ← map_pow, hA, map_one]
    apply (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff q (m i)).mp
    have h := congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd hp
    change q • (1 : ZMod (m i)) = 0 at h
    simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] using h
  have hmi : m i = q := ((Nat.dvd_prime (Fact.out : q.Prime)).mp hmdiv).resolve_left
    (Nat.ne_of_gt (hm i))
  let ec := (ZMod.ringEquivCongr hmi).toAddEquiv.toMultiplicative
  refine ⟨ec.toMonoidHom.comp ψ, ?_⟩
  intro hχ
  apply hi
  apply ec.injective
  exact hχ.trans (map_one ec).symm

/-- Conjugation by an ambient element as a continuous automorphism of a normal subgroup. -/
noncomputable def conjNormalContinuousMulEquiv
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (g : G) : N ≃ₜ* N :=
  { toMulEquiv := MulAut.conjNormal g
    continuous_toFun := by
      apply Continuous.subtype_mk
      change Continuous fun x : N => g * (x : G) * g⁻¹
      exact
        ((continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : N => g).mul continuous_subtype_val).mul
          (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : N => g⁻¹)
    continuous_invFun := by
      apply Continuous.subtype_mk
      change Continuous fun x : N => g⁻¹ * (x : G) * (g⁻¹)⁻¹
      exact
        ((continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : N => g⁻¹).mul continuous_subtype_val).mul
          (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : N => (g⁻¹)⁻¹) }

/-- Transports equalizers along algebra equivalences that intertwine both defining maps. -/
def AlgHom.equalizerCongr {R A A' B B' : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    [Semiring A] [Semiring A'] [Semiring B] [Semiring B']
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R A'] [Algebra R B] [Algebra R B']
    (eA : A ≃ₐ[R] A') (eB : B ≃ₐ[R] B')
    {f g : A →ₐ[R] B} {f' g' : A' →ₐ[R] B'}
    (hf : eB.toAlgHom.comp f = f'.comp eA) (hg : eB.toAlgHom.comp g = g'.comp eA) :
    AlgHom.equalizer f g ≃ₐ[R] AlgHom.equalizer f' g' :=
  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom
    (AlgHom.codRestrict (eA.toAlgHom.comp (equalizer f g).val) _ <| by
      intro x
      simp only [coe_comp, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, Subalgebra.coe_val, Function.comp_apply,
        mem_equalizer]
      rw [← hf', x.2, hg'])
    (AlgHom.codRestrict (eA.symm.toAlgHom.comp (equalizer f' g').val) _ <| by
      intro x
      simp only [coe_comp, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, Subalgebra.coe_val, Function.comp_apply,
        mem_equalizer]
      apply eB.injective
      rw [hf', hg', AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, x.2])
    (by ext x; exact eA.apply_symm_apply x)
    (by ext x; exact eA.symm_apply_apply x)
   where
    hf' (x) : eB (f x) = f' (eA x) := DFunLike.congr_fun hf x
    hg' (x) : eB (g x) = g' (eA x) := DFunLike.congr_fun hg x

/-- Identifies equalizers when both defining algebra homomorphisms are equal. -/
def AlgHom.equalizerCongrOfEq {R A B : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Semiring B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] {f g f' g' : A →ₐ[R] B}
    (hf : f = f') (hg : g = g') :
    AlgHom.equalizer f g ≃ₐ[R] AlgHom.equalizer f' g' :=
  AlgHom.equalizerCongr AlgEquiv.refl AlgEquiv.refl
    (by subst hf; ext x; rfl) (by subst hg; ext x; rfl)

end Equalizer

name: AlgHom.eq_compRight_of_no_nontrivial_isIdempotentElem
statement:
lemma AlgHom.eq_compRight_of_no_nontrivial_isIdempotentElem {R E F : Type*} [_root_.Finite E]
    [Nonempty E] [CommRing R] (H : ∀ e : R, IsIdempotentElem e → e = 0 ∨ e = 1)
    (f : (E → R) →ₐ[R] F → R) : ∃ (σ : F → E), f = .compRight R R σ
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  cases nonempty_fintype E
  classical
  have hor (i) (j) : f (Pi.single j 1) i = 0 ∨ f (Pi.single j 1) i = 1 := by
    apply H
    unfold IsIdempotentElem
    rw [← Pi.mul_apply, ← map_mul, ← Pi.single_mul_left]
    simp only [Pi.single_eq_same, one_mul]
  have (x : F) : ∃ (y : E), f (Pi.single y 1) x = 1 := by
    by_contra! hc
    replace hc (y : E) : f (Pi.single y 1) x = 0 := by
      obtain (h|h) := hor x y
      · assumption
      · simp [hc] at h

    (AlgHom.codRestrict (eA.symm.toAlgHom.comp (equalizer f' g').val) _ <| by
      intro x
      simp only [coe_comp, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, Subalgebra.coe_val, Function.comp_apply,
        mem_equalizer]
      apply eB.injective
      rw [hf', hg', AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, x.2])
    (by ext x; exact eA.apply_symm_apply x)
    (by ext x; exact eA.symm_apply_apply x)
   where
    hf' (x) : eB (f x) = f' (eA x) := DFunLike.congr_fun hf x
    hg' (x) : eB (g x) = g' (eA x) := DFunLike.congr_fun hg x

/-- Identifies equalizers when both defining algebra homomorphisms are equal. -/
def AlgHom.equalizerCongrOfEq {R A B : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Semiring B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] {f g f' g' : A →ₐ[R] B}
    (hf : f = f') (hg : g = g') :
    AlgHom.equalizer f g ≃ₐ[R] AlgHom.equalizer f' g' :=
  AlgHom.equalizerCongr AlgEquiv.refl AlgEquiv.refl
    (by subst hf; ext x; rfl) (by subst hg; ext x; rfl)

end Equalizer

/-- Precomposition with `σ` as an `R`-algebra homomorphism between function algebras. -/
@[simps!]
def AlgHom.compRight (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (σ : E → F) :
    (F → S) →ₐ[R] E → S :=
  AlgHom.pi (fun f ↦ Pi.evalAlgHom R _ (σ f))

instance [Finite F] (σ τ : E → F) : Finite (Function.Coequalizer σ τ) :=
  Finite.of_surjective _ (Function.Coequalizer.mk_surjective σ τ)

/-- Precomposition with `σ` as a ring homomorphism between function rings. -/
def RingHom.compRight (R : Type*) [CommRing R] {E F : Type*} (σ : E → F) :
    (F → R) →+* (E → R) :=
  RingHom.pi (fun f ↦ Pi.evalRingHom _ (σ f))

/-- Identifies functions equal after precomposition by `σ` and `τ` with functions
on their coequalizer. -/
def AlgHom.equalizerCompRightEquiv (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (σ τ : E → F) :
    AlgHom.equalizer (AlgHom.compRight R S σ) (AlgHom.compRight R S τ) ≃ₐ[R]
      Function.Coequalizer σ τ → S :=
  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom
    (AlgHom.pi (Function.Coequalizer.desc σ τ
      (fun f ↦ (Pi.evalAlgHom R (fun _ ↦ S) f).comp
        (equalizer (AlgHom.compRight R S σ) (AlgHom.compRight R S τ)).val)
        (by ext f ⟨x, hx⟩; exact congrFun hx f)))
    (codRestrict (.compRight _ _ (Function.Coequalizer.mk _ _))
      (equalizer _ _)
      (fun x ↦ by ext e; simp only [AlgHom.compRight_apply]; rw [Function.Coequalizer.condition]))
    (by
      ext f x
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Function.Coequalizer.mk_surjective _ _ x
      rfl)
    (by ext f x; rfl)

instance (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [Finite E] [Finite F] (σ τ : E → F) :
    Algebra.IsFiniteSplit R
      (AlgHom.equalizer (AlgHom.compRight R R σ) (AlgHom.compRight R R τ)) :=
  Algebra.IsFiniteSplit.of_algEquiv (AlgHom.equalizerCompRightEquiv R R σ τ).symm

lemma AlgHom.eq_compRight_of_no_nontrivial_isIdempotentElem {R E F : Type*} [_root_.Finite E]
    [Nonempty E] [CommRing R] (H : ∀ e : R, IsIdempotentElem e → e = 0 ∨ e = 1)
    (f : (E → R) →ₐ[R] F → R) : ∃ (σ : F → E), f = .compRight R R σ := by
  nontriviality R
  cases nonempty_fintype E
  classical
  have hor (i) (j) : f (Pi.single j 1) i = 0 ∨ f (Pi.single j 1) i = 1 := by
    apply H
    unfold IsIdempotentElem
    rw [← Pi.mul_apply, ← map_mul, ← Pi.single_mul_left]
    simp only [Pi.single_eq_same, one_mul]
  have (x : F) : ∃ (y : E), f (Pi.single y 1) x = 1 := by
    by_contra! hc
    replace hc (y : E) : f (Pi.single y 1) x = 0 := by
      obtain (h|h) := hor x y
      · assumption
      · simp [hc] at h
    have : 1 = ∑ y : E, f (Pi.single y 1) x := by
      rw [← Fintype.sum_apply]
      rw [← map_sum, Finset.univ_sum_single, ← Pi.one_def, map_one, Pi.one_apply]
    simp_rw [hc] at this
    exact one_ne_zero (by simpa only [Finset.sum_const_zero] using this)
  have (x : F) : ∃! (y : E), f (Pi.single y 1) x = 1 := by
    apply existsUnique_of_exists_of_unique
    · exact this x
    · intro a b ha hb
      by_contra! h
      have : (Pi.single a 1) * (Pi.single b 1 : E → R) = 0 := by
        simp [← Pi.single_mul_left, h]
      apply_fun ((f ·) · x) at this
      simp [ha, hb] at this
  choose σ hσ hun using this
  use σ
  ext x i
  induction x using Pi.single_induction with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, Pi.zero_apply, AlgHom.compRight_apply]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
  | single j r =>
      have : Pi.single j r = r • (Pi.single j 1 : E → R) := by simp [← Pi.single_smul]
      rw [this]
      simp only [map_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, AlgHom.compRight_apply]
      congr
      obtain (h|h) := hor i j
      · have : j ≠ σ i := by
          intro hj
          subst hj
          simp [hσ] at h
        simp [this, h]
      · have := hun i j h
        subst this
        simp [hσ]

lemma AlgHom.eq_compRight_of_no_nontrivial_isIdempotentElem' {R E F : Type*} [_root_.Finite E]
    [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] (H : ∀ e : R, IsIdempotentElem e → e = 0 ∨ e = 1)
    (f : (E → R) →ₐ[R] F → R) : ∃ (σ : F → E), f = .compRight R R σ := by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty E
  · have : Subsingleton (F → R) := f.codomain_trivial
    cases isEmpty_or_nonempty F
    · use default
      apply Subsingleton.elim
    · simpa using false_of_nontrivial_of_subsingleton (F → R)
  · apply eq_compRight_of_no_nontrivial_isIdempotentElem H

lemma IsLocalRing.isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {e : R} : IsIdempotentElem e ↔ e = 0 ∨ e = 1 := by
  refine ⟨fun he ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain (h|h) := IsLocalRing.isUnit_or_isUnit_one_sub_self e
    · exact Or.inr ((IsIdempotentElem.iff_eq_one_of_isUnit h).mp he)
    · exact Or.inl
        (sub_eq_self.mp ((IsIdempotentElem.iff_eq_one_of_isUnit h).mp he.one_sub))
  · rintro (h|h) <;> subst h
    · exact IsIdempotentElem.zero
    · exact IsIdempotentElem.one

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.isGalois_of_mono_to_binaryProduct
statement:
theorem isGalois_of_mono_to_binaryProduct {X Y Z : C}
    [IsGalois X] [IsGalois Y] [IsConnected Z]
    (i : Z ⟶ X ⨯ Y) [Mono i] :
    IsGalois Z
proof:
:= by
  let F := CategoryTheory.GaloisCategory.getFiberFunctor C
  apply (isGalois_iff_pretransitive F Z).mpr
  constructor
  intro a b
  obtain ⟨σX, hσX⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq (Aut X)
    (F.map (i ≫ prod.fst) a) (F.map (i ≫ prod.fst) b)
  obtain ⟨σY, hσY⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq (Aut Y)
    (F.map (i ≫ prod.snd) a) (F.map (i ≫ prod.snd) b)
  change F.map σX.hom (F.map (i ≫ prod.fst) a) = F.map (i ≫ prod.fst) b at hσX
  change F.map σY.hom (F.map (i ≫ prod.snd) a) = F.map (i ≫ prod.snd) b at hσY
  let τ : X ⨯ Y ≅ X ⨯ Y := prod.mapIso σX σY
  have hfst :
      F.map prod.fst (F.map (i ≫ τ.hom) a) =
        F.map prod.fst (F.map i b) := by
    calc
      _ = F.map σX.hom (F.map (i ≫ prod.fst) a) := by
        simp only [← FintypeCat.comp_apply, ← F.map_comp]
        exact congrArg (fun f : Z ⟶ X => F.map f a) (by simp [τ, prod.mapIso])
      _ = F.map (i ≫ prod.fst) b := hσX
      _ = F.map prod.fst (F.map i b) := by
        simp only [F.map_comp, FintypeCat.comp_apply]
  have hsnd :
      F.map prod.snd (F.map (i ≫ τ.hom) a) =
        F.map prod.snd (F.map i b) := by
    calc
      _ = F.map σY.hom (F.map (i ≫ prod.snd) a) := by
        simp only [← FintypeCat.comp_apply, ← F.map_comp]
        exact congrArg (fun f : Z ⟶ Y => F.map f a) (by simp [τ, prod.mapIso])
      _ = F.map (i ≫ prod.snd) b := hσY
      _ = F.map prod.snd (F.map i b) := by
        simp only [F.map_comp, FintypeCat.comp_apply]
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := connected_component_unique F a b (i ≫ τ.hom) i
    (fiberBinaryProduct_ext F hfst hsnd)
  exact ⟨σ, hσ⟩

private lemma fiberBinaryProduct_ext {X Y : C} {a b : F.obj (X ⨯ Y)}
    (hfst : F.map prod.fst a = F.map prod.fst b)
    (hsnd : F.map prod.snd a = F.map prod.snd b) :

  let e := fiberBinaryProductEquiv F X Y

  apply Prod.ext
  · have ha : F.map prod.fst a = (e a).1 := by
      simpa only [e, Prod.eta, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using
        fiberBinaryProductEquiv_symm_fst_apply F (e a).1 (e a).2
    have hb : F.map prod.fst b = (e b).1 := by
      simpa only [e, Prod.eta, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using
        fiberBinaryProductEquiv_symm_fst_apply F (e b).1 (e b).2
    exact ha.symm.trans (hfst.trans hb)
  · have ha : F.map prod.snd a = (e a).2 := by
      simpa only [e, Prod.eta, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using
        fiberBinaryProductEquiv_symm_snd_apply F (e a).1 (e a).2
    have hb : F.map prod.snd b = (e b).2 := by
      simpa only [e, Prod.eta, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using
        fiberBinaryProductEquiv_symm_snd_apply F (e b).1 (e b).2
    exact ha.symm.trans (hsnd.trans hb)

statement:
theorem autMapHom_prod_injective_of_mono {X Y Z : C}
    [IsGalois X] [IsGalois Y] [IsConnected Z]
    (i : Z ⟶ X ⨯ Y) [Mono i] :
    Function.Injective
      (MonoidHom.prod (autMapHom (i ≫ prod.fst)) (autMapHom (i ≫ prod.snd)))
proof:
:= by
  intro σ τ hστ
  have hfst : autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) σ = autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) τ := by
    have h := congrArg (fun p : Aut X × Aut Y ↦ p.1) hστ
    change autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) σ = autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) τ at h
    exact h
  have hsnd : autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) σ = autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) τ := by
    have h := congrArg (fun p : Aut X × Aut Y ↦ p.2) hστ
    change autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) σ = autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) τ at h
    exact h
  apply Aut.ext
  rw [← cancel_mono i]
  apply prod.hom_ext
  · simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← comp_autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) σ, ← comp_autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) τ, hfst]
  · simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← comp_autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) σ, ← comp_autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) τ, hsnd]

statement:
theorem exists_common_galois_cover (X Y : C) [IsGalois X] [IsGalois Y] :
    ∃ (Z : C) (hZ : IsGalois Z),
      letI
proof:
:= hZ
      ∃ (f : Z ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ Y),
        Function.Injective (MonoidHom.prod (autMapHom f) (autMapHom g)) := by
  let F := CategoryTheory.GaloisCategory.getFiberFunctor C
  let x : F.obj X := Classical.choice inferInstance
  let y : F.obj Y := Classical.choice inferInstance
  obtain ⟨Z, i, _, _, hZ, hi⟩ := fiber_in_connected_component F (X ⨯ Y)
    ((fiberBinaryProductEquiv F X Y).symm (x, y))
  let : IsConnected Z := hZ
  let : Mono i := hi
  have hGalois : IsGalois Z := isGalois_of_mono_to_binaryProduct i
  let : IsGalois Z := hGalois
  exact ⟨Z, hGalois, i ≫ prod.fst, i ≫ prod.snd,
    autMapHom_prod_injective_of_mono i⟩

      _ = F.map σX.hom (F.map (i ≫ prod.fst) a) := by
        simp only [← FintypeCat.comp_apply, ← F.map_comp]
        exact congrArg (fun f : Z ⟶ X => F.map f a) (by simp [τ, prod.mapIso])
      _ = F.map (i ≫ prod.fst) b := hσX
      _ = F.map prod.fst (F.map i b) := by
        simp only [F.map_comp, FintypeCat.comp_apply]
  have hsnd :
      F.map prod.snd (F.map (i ≫ τ.hom) a) =
        F.map prod.snd (F.map i b) := by
    calc
      _ = F.map σY.hom (F.map (i ≫ prod.snd) a) := by
        simp only [← FintypeCat.comp_apply, ← F.map_comp]
        exact congrArg (fun f : Z ⟶ Y => F.map f a) (by simp [τ, prod.mapIso])
      _ = F.map (i ≫ prod.snd) b := hσY
      _ = F.map prod.snd (F.map i b) := by
        simp only [F.map_comp, FintypeCat.comp_apply]
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := connected_component_unique F a b (i ≫ τ.hom) i
    (fiberBinaryProduct_ext F hfst hsnd)
  exact ⟨σ, hσ⟩

/-- If a connected object is a subobject of a product of two Galois objects,
the two induced maps on automorphism groups are jointly injective. -/
@[stacks 03SF "the common Galois group embeds in the product"]
theorem autMapHom_prod_injective_of_mono {X Y Z : C}
    [IsGalois X] [IsGalois Y] [IsConnected Z]
    (i : Z ⟶ X ⨯ Y) [Mono i] :
    Function.Injective
      (MonoidHom.prod (autMapHom (i ≫ prod.fst)) (autMapHom (i ≫ prod.snd))) := by
  intro σ τ hστ
  have hfst : autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) σ = autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) τ := by
    have h := congrArg (fun p : Aut X × Aut Y ↦ p.1) hστ
    change autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) σ = autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) τ at h
    exact h
  have hsnd : autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) σ = autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) τ := by
    have h := congrArg (fun p : Aut X × Aut Y ↦ p.2) hστ
    change autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) σ = autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) τ at h
    exact h
  apply Aut.ext
  rw [← cancel_mono i]
  apply prod.hom_ext
  · simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← comp_autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) σ, ← comp_autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) τ, hfst]
  · simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← comp_autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) σ, ← comp_autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) τ, hsnd]

/-- Two Galois objects have a common Galois cover.  Its automorphism group
maps injectively to the product of the two original automorphism groups. -/

@[stacks 03SF "common domination of two Galois covers"]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_ambient_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition
statement:
theorem exists_ambient_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ∀ {A₀ B₀ : Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))},
      IsOpen A₀ → IsOpen B₀ →
      A₀ ∪ B₀ =
        ({closedPoint (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})}ᶜ :
          Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) →
      Disjoint A₀ B₀ → A₀.Nonempty → B₀.Nonempty →
      ∃ a b : Ideal C,
        Ideal.span {x} ≤ a ∧ Ideal.span {x} ≤ b ∧
        a ≠ ⊤ ∧ b ≠ ⊤ ∧
        a ⊓ b = (Ideal.span {x}).radical ∧
        (a ⊔ b).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
  let I : Ideal C := Ideal.span {x}
  let D := C ⧸ I
  let q : C →+* D := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsLocalHom q :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro A₀ B₀ hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hinf, hradical⟩ :=
    exists_proper_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition
      hdim x hx hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  let A : Ideal C := a.comap q
  let B : Ideal C := b.comap q
  have hIA : I ≤ A := by
    rw [← Ideal.mk_ker (I := I), RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
    exact Ideal.comap_mono bot_le
  have hIB : I ≤ B := by
    rw [← Ideal.mk_ker (I := I), RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
    exact Ideal.comap_mono bot_le
  have hA : A ≠ ⊤ := Ideal.comap_ne_top q ha
  have hB : B ≠ ⊤ := Ideal.comap_ne_top q hb
  have hABinf : A ⊓ B = I.radical := by
    calc
      A ⊓ B = Ideal.comap q (a ⊓ b) := (Ideal.comap_inf q a b).symm
      _ = Ideal.comap q (nilradical D) := by rw [hinf]
      _ = Ideal.comap q (Ideal.radical ⊥) := rfl
      _ = Ideal.radical (Ideal.comap q ⊥) := Ideal.comap_radical q ⊥
      _ = I.radical := by
        rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker]
  have hcomapSup : Ideal.comap q (a ⊔ b) = A ⊔ B := by
    calc
      Ideal.comap q (a ⊔ b) =
          Ideal.comap q ((A ⊔ B).map q) := by
        congr 1
        dsimp only [A, B]
        exact (Ideal.map_sup_comap_of_surjective q
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a b).symm
      _ = (A ⊔ B) ⊔ Ideal.comap q ⊥ :=
        Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (A ⊔ B)
      _ = A ⊔ B := by
        rw [sup_eq_left]
        exact (Ideal.comap_mono bot_le).trans le_sup_left
  have hABradical : (A ⊔ B).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
    have h := congrArg (Ideal.comap q) hradical
    rw [Ideal.comap_radical, hcomapSup,
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap q] at h
    exact h
  exact ⟨A, B, hIA, hIB, hA, hB, hABinf, hABradical⟩

open IsLocalRing TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale

universe u

/-- An irreducible component that meets an open set lies entirely on one
side of any disjoint open partition of that open set. -/
theorem irreducibleComponent_inter_subset_partition_side
    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (Z : Set X) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X)
    {U A B : Set X} (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B)
    (hcover : A ∪ B = U) (hdisjoint : Disjoint A B) :
    Z ∩ U ⊆ A ∨ Z ∩ U ⊆ B := by
  classical
  by_cases hleft : Z ∩ U ⊆ A
  · exact Or.inl hleft
  · right
    obtain ⟨y, hyZU, hyA⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hleft
    have hyB : y ∈ B := by
      have hyAB : y ∈ A ∪ B := hcover.symm ▸ hyZU.2
      exact hyAB.resolve_left hyA
    intro z hzZU
    by_contra hzB
    have hzA : z ∈ A := by
      have hzAB : z ∈ A ∪ B := hcover.symm ▸ hzZU.2
      exact hzAB.resolve_right hzB
    obtain ⟨w, hwZ, hwAB⟩ :=
      hZ.1.2 A B hA hB ⟨z, hzZU.1, hzA⟩ ⟨y, hyZU.1, hyB⟩
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint hwAB.1 hwAB.2

/-- Components assigned to opposite sides of a disjoint partition can meet
only outside the partitioned open set. -/
theorem inter_subset_compl_of_component_partition_sides
    {X : Type u} {Z W U A B : Set X}
    (hZ : Z ∩ U ⊆ A) (hW : W ∩ U ⊆ B)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint A B) :
    Z ∩ W ⊆ Uᶜ := by
  intro z hzZW hzU
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint
    (hZ ⟨hzZW.1, hzU⟩) (hW ⟨hzZW.2, hzU⟩)

/-- A minimal prime over a principal ideal in a local ring of dimension at
least three cannot be the maximal ideal. -/
theorem minimalPrime_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (P : Ideal C) (hP : P ∈ (Ideal.span {x}).minimalPrimes) :
    P ≠ maximalIdeal C := by
  intro hPmax
  have hheight : P.height ≤ 1 :=
    Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes
      (Ideal.span {x}) P hP
  have hdim' : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
      ((P.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [hPmax, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim]
    exact hdim
  have : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
      ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
    hdim'.trans (WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr hheight)
  norm_num at this

/-- A minimal prime of a principal quotient in dimension at least three is
not the quotient maximal ideal. -/
theorem minimalPrime_quotient_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C)
    (Q : Ideal (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))
    (hQ : Q ∈ minimalPrimes (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    Q ≠ maximalIdeal (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := by
  let I : Ideal C := Ideal.span {x}
  let q : C →+* C ⧸ I := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  have hIle : I ≤ maximalIdeal C :=
    (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : Nontrivial (C ⧸ I) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top hIle
  let : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsLocalHom q :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hcomap : Q.comap q ∈ I.minimalPrimes := by
    have hQ' : Q ∈ (⊥ : Ideal (C ⧸ I)).minimalPrimes := hQ
    have := Ideal.minimalPrimes_comap_of_surjective
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective hQ'
    simpa only [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, q, Ideal.mk_ker] using this
  intro hQmax
  apply minimalPrime_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal hdim x (Q.comap q) hcomap
  rw [hQmax]
  exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap q

/-- Every irreducible component of a principal quotient in dimension at
least three contains a point different from the closed point. -/
theorem irreducibleComponent_quotient_span_singleton_inter_puncture_nonempty
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C)
    (Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})))
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    (Z ∩ ({closedPoint (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})}ᶜ :
      Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})))).Nonempty := by
  let B := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let : Nontrivial B :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing B :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let Q : Ideal B := PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z
  have hQ : Q ∈ minimalPrimes B := by
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal_irreducibleComponents B]
    exact ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQ.isPrime
  let q : PrimeSpectrum B := ⟨Q, inferInstance⟩
  have hqZ : q ∈ Z := by
    have hclosed : IsClosed Z := isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z hZ
    have hzero : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q = Z := by
      change PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z) = Z
      rw [PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure,
        hclosed.closure_eq]
    rw [← hzero]
    exact show Q ≤ q.asIdeal from le_rfl
  have hqne : q ≠ closedPoint B := by
    intro hq
    apply minimalPrime_quotient_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal hdim x hx Q hQ
    exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hq
  refine ⟨q, hqZ, ?_⟩
  simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hqne

end AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale

/-- A prime containing the intersection of a finite family of ideals
contains one member of that family. -/
theorem exists_mem_le_of_sInf_le_prime_of_finite
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C]
    {S : Set (Ideal C)} (hS : S.Finite)
    {P : Ideal C} [P.IsPrime] (h : sInf S ≤ P) :
    ∃ I ∈ S, I ≤ P := by
  have h' := h
  rw [← hS.coe_toFinset, ← hS.toFinset.inf_id_eq_sInf] at h'
  obtain ⟨I, hI, hIP⟩ :=
    (inferInstance : P.IsPrime).inf_le'.mp h'
  exact ⟨I, hS.mem_toFinset.mp hI, hIP⟩

/-- If two nonempty finite families of prime ideals have all cross-component
intersections supported at the closed point, then the radical of the sum of
their intersections is the maximal ideal. -/
theorem radical_sup_sInf_eq_maximalIdeal_of_cross_zeroLocus
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C]
    {S T : Set (Ideal C)}
    (hSfinite : S.Finite) (hTfinite : T.Finite)
    (hSnonempty : S.Nonempty) (hTnonempty : T.Nonempty)
    (hSprime : ∀ P ∈ S, P.IsPrime)
    (hTprime : ∀ Q ∈ T, Q.IsPrime)
    (hcross : ∀ P ∈ S, ∀ Q ∈ T,
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q ⊆
        ({closedPoint C} : Set (PrimeSpectrum C))) :
    (sInf S ⊔ sInf T).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
  have hSle : sInf S ≤ maximalIdeal C := by
    obtain ⟨P, hPS⟩ := hSnonempty
    exact (sInf_le hPS).trans <|

/-- An irreducible component that meets an open set lies entirely on one
side of any disjoint open partition of that open set. -/
theorem irreducibleComponent_inter_subset_partition_side
    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (Z : Set X) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X)
    {U A B : Set X} (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B)
    (hcover : A ∪ B = U) (hdisjoint : Disjoint A B) :
    Z ∩ U ⊆ A ∨ Z ∩ U ⊆ B := by
  classical
  by_cases hleft : Z ∩ U ⊆ A
  · exact Or.inl hleft
  · right
    obtain ⟨y, hyZU, hyA⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hleft
    have hyB : y ∈ B := by
      have hyAB : y ∈ A ∪ B := hcover.symm ▸ hyZU.2
      exact hyAB.resolve_left hyA
    intro z hzZU
    by_contra hzB
    have hzA : z ∈ A := by
      have hzAB : z ∈ A ∪ B := hcover.symm ▸ hzZU.2
      exact hzAB.resolve_right hzB
    obtain ⟨w, hwZ, hwAB⟩ :=
      hZ.1.2 A B hA hB ⟨z, hzZU.1, hzA⟩ ⟨y, hyZU.1, hyB⟩
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint hwAB.1 hwAB.2

/-- Components assigned to opposite sides of a disjoint partition can meet
only outside the partitioned open set. -/
theorem inter_subset_compl_of_component_partition_sides
    {X : Type u} {Z W U A B : Set X}
    (hZ : Z ∩ U ⊆ A) (hW : W ∩ U ⊆ B)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint A B) :
    Z ∩ W ⊆ Uᶜ := by
  intro z hzZW hzU
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint
    (hZ ⟨hzZW.1, hzU⟩) (hW ⟨hzZW.2, hzU⟩)

/-- A minimal prime over a principal ideal in a local ring of dimension at
least three cannot be the maximal ideal. -/
theorem minimalPrime_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (P : Ideal C) (hP : P ∈ (Ideal.span {x}).minimalPrimes) :
    P ≠ maximalIdeal C := by
  intro hPmax
  have hheight : P.height ≤ 1 :=
    Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes
      (Ideal.span {x}) P hP
  have hdim' : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
      ((P.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [hPmax, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim]
    exact hdim
  have : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
      ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
    hdim'.trans (WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr hheight)
  norm_num at this

/-- A minimal prime of a principal quotient in dimension at least three is
not the quotient maximal ideal. -/
theorem minimalPrime_quotient_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C)
    (Q : Ideal (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))
    (hQ : Q ∈ minimalPrimes (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    Q ≠ maximalIdeal (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := by
  let I : Ideal C := Ideal.span {x}
  let q : C →+* C ⧸ I := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  have hIle : I ≤ maximalIdeal C :=
    (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : Nontrivial (C ⧸ I) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top hIle
  let : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsLocalHom q :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hcomap : Q.comap q ∈ I.minimalPrimes := by
    have hQ' : Q ∈ (⊥ : Ideal (C ⧸ I)).minimalPrimes := hQ
    have := Ideal.minimalPrimes_comap_of_surjective
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective hQ'
    simpa only [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, q, Ideal.mk_ker] using this
  intro hQmax
  apply minimalPrime_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal hdim x (Q.comap q) hcomap
  rw [hQmax]
  exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap q

/-- Every irreducible component of a principal quotient in dimension at
least three contains a point different from the closed point. -/
theorem irreducibleComponent_quotient_span_singleton_inter_puncture_nonempty
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C)
    (Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})))
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    (Z ∩ ({closedPoint (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})}ᶜ :
      Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})))).Nonempty := by
  let B := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let : Nontrivial B :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing B :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let Q : Ideal B := PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z
  have hQ : Q ∈ minimalPrimes B := by
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal_irreducibleComponents B]
    exact ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQ.isPrime
  let q : PrimeSpectrum B := ⟨Q, inferInstance⟩
  have hqZ : q ∈ Z := by
    have hclosed : IsClosed Z := isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z hZ
    have hzero : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q = Z := by
      change PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z) = Z
      rw [PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure,
        hclosed.closure_eq]
    rw [← hzero]
    exact show Q ≤ q.asIdeal from le_rfl
  have hqne : q ≠ closedPoint B := by
    intro hq
    apply minimalPrime_quotient_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal hdim x hx Q hQ
    exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hq
  refine ⟨q, hqZ, ?_⟩
  simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hqne

end AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale

open IsLocalRing

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale

universe u

/-- A prime containing the intersection of a finite family of ideals
contains one member of that family. -/
theorem exists_mem_le_of_sInf_le_prime_of_finite
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C]
    {S : Set (Ideal C)} (hS : S.Finite)
    {P : Ideal C} [P.IsPrime] (h : sInf S ≤ P) :
    ∃ I ∈ S, I ≤ P := by
  have h' := h
  rw [← hS.coe_toFinset, ← hS.toFinset.inf_id_eq_sInf] at h'
  obtain ⟨I, hI, hIP⟩ :=
    (inferInstance : P.IsPrime).inf_le'.mp h'
  exact ⟨I, hS.mem_toFinset.mp hI, hIP⟩

/-- If two nonempty finite families of prime ideals have all cross-component
intersections supported at the closed point, then the radical of the sum of
their intersections is the maximal ideal. -/
theorem radical_sup_sInf_eq_maximalIdeal_of_cross_zeroLocus
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C]
    {S T : Set (Ideal C)}
    (hSfinite : S.Finite) (hTfinite : T.Finite)
    (hSnonempty : S.Nonempty) (hTnonempty : T.Nonempty)
    (hSprime : ∀ P ∈ S, P.IsPrime)
    (hTprime : ∀ Q ∈ T, Q.IsPrime)
    (hcross : ∀ P ∈ S, ∀ Q ∈ T,
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q ⊆
        ({closedPoint C} : Set (PrimeSpectrum C))) :
    (sInf S ⊔ sInf T).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
  have hSle : sInf S ≤ maximalIdeal C := by
    obtain ⟨P, hPS⟩ := hSnonempty
    exact (sInf_le hPS).trans <|
      le_maximalIdeal (hSprime P hPS).ne_top
  have hTle : sInf T ≤ maximalIdeal C := by
    obtain ⟨Q, hQT⟩ := hTnonempty
    exact (sInf_le hQT).trans <|
      le_maximalIdeal (hTprime Q hQT).ne_top
  have hsup : sInf S ⊔ sInf T ≤ maximalIdeal C := sup_le hSle hTle
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).isPrime.radical_le_iff.mpr hsup
  · rw [Ideal.radical_eq_sInf, le_sInf_iff]
    intro K hK
    let : K.IsPrime := hK.2
    have hSK : sInf S ≤ K := le_sup_left.trans hK.1
    have hTK : sInf T ≤ K := le_sup_right.trans hK.1
    obtain ⟨P, hPS, hPK⟩ :=
      exists_mem_le_of_sInf_le_prime_of_finite hSfinite hSK
    obtain ⟨Q, hQT, hQK⟩ :=
      exists_mem_le_of_sInf_le_prime_of_finite hTfinite hTK
    let k : PrimeSpectrum C := ⟨K, inferInstance⟩
    have hk : k ∈
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q :=
      ⟨hPK, hQK⟩
    have hkclosed : k = closedPoint C :=
      Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp (hcross P hPS Q hQT hk)
    exact (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hkclosed).ge

/-- The previous reduction specialized to two finite subfamilies of the
minimal primes of an ideal in a Noetherian local ring. -/
theorem radical_sup_sInf_eq_maximalIdeal_of_minimalPrime_cross_zeroLocus
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (I : Ideal C) {S T : Set (Ideal C)}
    (hS : S ⊆ I.minimalPrimes) (hT : T ⊆ I.minimalPrimes)
    (hSnonempty : S.Nonempty) (hTnonempty : T.Nonempty)
    (hcross : ∀ P ∈ S, ∀ Q ∈ T,
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q ⊆
        ({closedPoint C} : Set (PrimeSpectrum C))) :
    (sInf S ⊔ sInf T).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
  exact radical_sup_sInf_eq_maximalIdeal_of_cross_zeroLocus
    (S := S) (T := T)
    ((I.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing C).subset hS)
    ((I.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing C).subset hT)
    hSnonempty hTnonempty
    (fun P hPS ↦ (hS hPS).isPrime)
    (fun Q hQT ↦ (hT hQT).isPrime)
    hcross

end AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale

/-- An open separation of a punctured principal hypersurface produces two
finite nonempty families of minimal primes covering all minimal primes, with
cross-component intersections supported at the closed point. -/
theorem exists_minimalPrime_partition_of_open_puncture_partition
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ∀ {A₀ B₀ : Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))},
      IsOpen A₀ → IsOpen B₀ →
      A₀ ∪ B₀ =
        ({closedPoint (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})}ᶜ :
          Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) →
      Disjoint A₀ B₀ → A₀.Nonempty → B₀.Nonempty →
      ∃ S T : Set (Ideal (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})),
        S.Nonempty ∧ T.Nonempty ∧
        S.Finite ∧ T.Finite ∧
        S ∪ T = minimalPrimes (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ∧
        Disjoint S T ∧
        ∀ P ∈ S, ∀ Q ∈ T,
          PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q ⊆
            ({closedPoint (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})} :
              Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) := by
  let D := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro A₀ B₀ hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  let U : Set (PrimeSpectrum D) := {closedPoint D}ᶜ
  let S : Set (Ideal D) :=
    {P | P ∈ minimalPrimes D ∧ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ U ⊆ A₀}
  let T : Set (Ideal D) :=
    {P | P ∈ minimalPrimes D ∧ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ U ⊆ B₀}
  have hcomponent (P : Ideal D) (hP : P ∈ minimalPrimes D) :
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum D) := by
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_ideal_mem_irreducibleComponents]
    simpa only [(hP.isPrime.isRadical.radical)] using hP
  have hcomponentMeets (P : Ideal D) (hP : P ∈ minimalPrimes D) :
      (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ U).Nonempty := by
    exact irreducibleComponent_quotient_span_singleton_inter_puncture_nonempty
      hdim x hx (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P) (hcomponent P hP)
  have hside (P : Ideal D) (hP : P ∈ minimalPrimes D) : P ∈ S ∨ P ∈ T := by
    have hsides := irreducibleComponent_inter_subset_partition_side
      (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P) (hcomponent P hP)
      hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint
    exact hsides.imp (fun h ↦ ⟨hP, h⟩) (fun h ↦ ⟨hP, h⟩)
  have hSnonempty : S.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨a, haA⟩ := hAnonempty
    have haU : a ∈ U := by
      change a ∈ ({closedPoint D}ᶜ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D))
      rw [← hcover]
      exact Or.inl haA
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hPa⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (I := (⊥ : Ideal D))
        (J := a.asIdeal) bot_le
    rcases hside P hP with hPS | hPT
    · exact ⟨P, hPS⟩
    · exfalso
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint haA
        (hPT.2 ⟨hPa, haU⟩)
  have hTnonempty : T.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨b, hbB⟩ := hBnonempty
    have hbU : b ∈ U := by
      change b ∈ ({closedPoint D}ᶜ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D))
      rw [← hcover]
      exact Or.inr hbB
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQb⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (I := (⊥ : Ideal D))
        (J := b.asIdeal) bot_le
    rcases hside Q hQ with hQS | hQT
    · exfalso
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint
        (hQS.2 ⟨hQb, hbU⟩) hbB
    · exact ⟨Q, hQT⟩
  have hSfinite : S.Finite :=
    (minimalPrimes.finite_of_isNoetherianRing D).subset fun _ h ↦ h.1
  have hTfinite : T.Finite :=
    (minimalPrimes.finite_of_isNoetherianRing D).subset fun _ h ↦ h.1
  have hSTcover : S ∪ T = minimalPrimes D := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact fun _ h ↦ h.elim (fun h ↦ h.1) (fun h ↦ h.1)
    · intro P hP
      exact hside P hP
  have hSTdisjoint : Disjoint S T := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro P hPS hPT
    obtain ⟨p, hpPU⟩ := hcomponentMeets P hPS.1

sum is the maximal ideal. -/
theorem exists_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition

    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)

      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|

          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx

          Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) →

  let D := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}

    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|

        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx

    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro A₀ B₀ hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  obtain ⟨S, T, hSnonempty, hTnonempty, hSfinite, hTfinite,
      hSTcover, _hSTdisjoint, hcross⟩ :=
    exists_minimalPrime_partition_of_open_puncture_partition
      hdim x hx hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  have hSsub : S ⊆ (⊥ : Ideal D).minimalPrimes := by
    intro P hPS
    change P ∈ minimalPrimes D
    rw [← hSTcover]
    exact Or.inl hPS

  exact ⟨sInf S, sInf T, hinf, hradical⟩

    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]

/-- A prime containing the intersection of a finite family of ideals
contains one member of that family. -/
theorem exists_mem_le_of_sInf_le_prime_of_finite
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C]
    {S : Set (Ideal C)} (hS : S.Finite)
    {P : Ideal C} [P.IsPrime] (h : sInf S ≤ P) :
    ∃ I ∈ S, I ≤ P := by
  have h' := h
  rw [← hS.coe_toFinset, ← hS.toFinset.inf_id_eq_sInf] at h'
  obtain ⟨I, hI, hIP⟩ :=
    (inferInstance : P.IsPrime).inf_le'.mp h'
  exact ⟨I, hS.mem_toFinset.mp hI, hIP⟩

/-- If two nonempty finite families of prime ideals have all cross-component
intersections supported at the closed point, then the radical of the sum of
their intersections is the maximal ideal. -/
theorem radical_sup_sInf_eq_maximalIdeal_of_cross_zeroLocus
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C]
    {S T : Set (Ideal C)}
    (hSfinite : S.Finite) (hTfinite : T.Finite)
    (hSnonempty : S.Nonempty) (hTnonempty : T.Nonempty)
    (hSprime : ∀ P ∈ S, P.IsPrime)
    (hTprime : ∀ Q ∈ T, Q.IsPrime)
    (hcross : ∀ P ∈ S, ∀ Q ∈ T,
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q ⊆
        ({closedPoint C} : Set (PrimeSpectrum C))) :
    (sInf S ⊔ sInf T).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
  have hSle : sInf S ≤ maximalIdeal C := by
    obtain ⟨P, hPS⟩ := hSnonempty
    exact (sInf_le hPS).trans <|
      le_maximalIdeal (hSprime P hPS).ne_top
  have hTle : sInf T ≤ maximalIdeal C := by
    obtain ⟨Q, hQT⟩ := hTnonempty
    exact (sInf_le hQT).trans <|
      le_maximalIdeal (hTprime Q hQT).ne_top
  have hsup : sInf S ⊔ sInf T ≤ maximalIdeal C := sup_le hSle hTle
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).isPrime.radical_le_iff.mpr hsup
  · rw [Ideal.radical_eq_sInf, le_sInf_iff]
    intro K hK
    let : K.IsPrime := hK.2
    have hSK : sInf S ≤ K := le_sup_left.trans hK.1
    have hTK : sInf T ≤ K := le_sup_right.trans hK.1
    obtain ⟨P, hPS, hPK⟩ :=
      exists_mem_le_of_sInf_le_prime_of_finite hSfinite hSK
    obtain ⟨Q, hQT, hQK⟩ :=
      exists_mem_le_of_sInf_le_prime_of_finite hTfinite hTK
    let k : PrimeSpectrum C := ⟨K, inferInstance⟩
    have hk : k ∈
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q :=
      ⟨hPK, hQK⟩
    have hkclosed : k = closedPoint C :=
      Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp (hcross P hPS Q hQT hk)
    exact (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hkclosed).ge

/-- The previous reduction specialized to two finite subfamilies of the
minimal primes of an ideal in a Noetherian local ring. -/
theorem radical_sup_sInf_eq_maximalIdeal_of_minimalPrime_cross_zeroLocus
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (I : Ideal C) {S T : Set (Ideal C)}
    (hS : S ⊆ I.minimalPrimes) (hT : T ⊆ I.minimalPrimes)
    (hSnonempty : S.Nonempty) (hTnonempty : T.Nonempty)
    (hcross : ∀ P ∈ S, ∀ Q ∈ T,
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q ⊆
        ({closedPoint C} : Set (PrimeSpectrum C))) :
    (sInf S ⊔ sInf T).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
  exact radical_sup_sInf_eq_maximalIdeal_of_cross_zeroLocus
    (S := S) (T := T)
    ((I.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing C).subset hS)
    ((I.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing C).subset hT)
    hSnonempty hTnonempty
    (fun P hPS ↦ (hS hPS).isPrime)
    (fun Q hQT ↦ (hT hQT).isPrime)
    hcross

end AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale

/-- An open separation of a punctured principal hypersurface produces two
finite nonempty families of minimal primes covering all minimal primes, with
cross-component intersections supported at the closed point. -/
theorem exists_minimalPrime_partition_of_open_puncture_partition
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C) :

      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ∀ {A₀ B₀ : Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))},
      IsOpen A₀ → IsOpen B₀ →
      A₀ ∪ B₀ =
        ({closedPoint (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})}ᶜ :
          Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) →
      Disjoint A₀ B₀ → A₀.Nonempty → B₀.Nonempty →
      ∃ S T : Set (Ideal (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})),
        S.Nonempty ∧ T.Nonempty ∧
        S.Finite ∧ T.Finite ∧
        S ∪ T = minimalPrimes (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ∧
        Disjoint S T ∧
        ∀ P ∈ S, ∀ Q ∈ T,
          PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q ⊆
            ({closedPoint (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})} :
              Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) := by
  let D := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro A₀ B₀ hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  let U : Set (PrimeSpectrum D) := {closedPoint D}ᶜ
  let S : Set (Ideal D) :=
    {P | P ∈ minimalPrimes D ∧ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ U ⊆ A₀}
  let T : Set (Ideal D) :=
    {P | P ∈ minimalPrimes D ∧ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ U ⊆ B₀}
  have hcomponent (P : Ideal D) (hP : P ∈ minimalPrimes D) :
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum D) := by
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_ideal_mem_irreducibleComponents]
    simpa only [(hP.isPrime.isRadical.radical)] using hP
  have hcomponentMeets (P : Ideal D) (hP : P ∈ minimalPrimes D) :
      (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ U).Nonempty := by
    exact irreducibleComponent_quotient_span_singleton_inter_puncture_nonempty
      hdim x hx (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P) (hcomponent P hP)
  have hside (P : Ideal D) (hP : P ∈ minimalPrimes D) : P ∈ S ∨ P ∈ T := by
    have hsides := irreducibleComponent_inter_subset_partition_side
      (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P) (hcomponent P hP)
      hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint
    exact hsides.imp (fun h ↦ ⟨hP, h⟩) (fun h ↦ ⟨hP, h⟩)
  have hSnonempty : S.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨a, haA⟩ := hAnonempty
    have haU : a ∈ U := by

      rw [← hcover]
      exact Or.inl haA
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hPa⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (I := (⊥ : Ideal D))
        (J := a.asIdeal) bot_le
    rcases hside P hP with hPS | hPT
    · exact ⟨P, hPS⟩
    · exfalso
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint haA
        (hPT.2 ⟨hPa, haU⟩)
  have hTnonempty : T.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨b, hbB⟩ := hBnonempty
    have hbU : b ∈ U := by
      change b ∈ ({closedPoint D}ᶜ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D))
      rw [← hcover]
      exact Or.inr hbB
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQb⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (I := (⊥ : Ideal D))
        (J := b.asIdeal) bot_le
    rcases hside Q hQ with hQS | hQT
    · exfalso
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint
        (hQS.2 ⟨hQb, hbU⟩) hbB
    · exact ⟨Q, hQT⟩
  have hSfinite : S.Finite :=
    (minimalPrimes.finite_of_isNoetherianRing D).subset fun _ h ↦ h.1
  have hTfinite : T.Finite :=
    (minimalPrimes.finite_of_isNoetherianRing D).subset fun _ h ↦ h.1

    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact fun _ h ↦ h.elim (fun h ↦ h.1) (fun h ↦ h.1)
    · intro P hP
      exact hside P hP
  have hSTdisjoint : Disjoint S T := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro P hPS hPT
    obtain ⟨p, hpPU⟩ := hcomponentMeets P hPS.1
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint
      (hPS.2 hpPU) (hPT.2 hpPU)
  refine ⟨S, T, hSnonempty, hTnonempty, hSfinite, hTfinite,
    hSTcover, hSTdisjoint, ?_⟩
  intro P hPS Q hQT p hp
  have hpNotU : p ∉ U := by
    intro hpU
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint
      (hPS.2 ⟨hp.1, hpU⟩) (hQT.2 ⟨hp.2, hpU⟩)
  simpa only [U, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, not_not]
    using hpNotU

theorem exists_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx

    ∀ {A₀ B₀ : Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))},
      IsOpen A₀ → IsOpen B₀ →

        a ⊓ b = nilradical (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ∧

  let D := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro A₀ B₀ hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  obtain ⟨S, T, hSnonempty, hTnonempty, hSfinite, hTfinite,
      hSTcover, _hSTdisjoint, hcross⟩ :=
    exists_minimalPrime_partition_of_open_puncture_partition
      hdim x hx hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty

    change P ∈ minimalPrimes D
    rw [← hSTcover]
    exact Or.inl hPS
  have hTsub : T ⊆ (⊥ : Ideal D).minimalPrimes := by

    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]

    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=

        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|

    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=

    ∀ {A₀ B₀ : Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))},

      A₀ ∪ B₀ =

    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|

    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'

    ∀ {A₀ B₀ : Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))},

      A₀ ∪ B₀ =
        ({closedPoint (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})}ᶜ :
          Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) →
      Disjoint A₀ B₀ → A₀.Nonempty → B₀.Nonempty →

  let : IsLocalRing D :=

  intro A₀ B₀ hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty

    exists_minimalPrime_partition_of_open_puncture_partition

  have hSsub : S ⊆ (⊥ : Ideal D).minimalPrimes := by
    intro P hPS
    change P ∈ minimalPrimes D
    rw [← hSTcover]
    exact Or.inl hPS
  have hTsub : T ⊆ (⊥ : Ideal D).minimalPrimes := by
    intro Q hQT

    rw [← hSTcover]
    exact Or.inr hQT

    intro hb

        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx

      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))

        (a ⊔ b).radical = maximalIdeal (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := by
  let D := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro A₀ B₀ hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hamax, hbmax, _haRadical, _hbRadical,

    exists_radical_nonmaximal_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition

        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective

      IsOpen A₀ → IsOpen B₀ →
      A₀ ∪ B₀ =
        ({closedPoint (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})}ᶜ :
          Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) →
      Disjoint A₀ B₀ → A₀.Nonempty → B₀.Nonempty →

        a ≠ ⊤ ∧ b ≠ ⊤ ∧
        a ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧ b ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧

      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsLocalHom q :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro A₀ B₀ hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hamax, hbmax, haRadical, hbRadical,
      hinf, hradical⟩ :=

      hdim x hx hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty

      _ = (maximalIdeal C).map q := congrArg (Ideal.map q) h
      _ = maximalIdeal D :=

          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective

    apply hbmax
    calc

        (Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective q
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b).symm
      _ = (maximalIdeal C).map q := congrArg (Ideal.map q) h
      _ = maximalIdeal D :=

          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective

    dsimp only [A]
    exact haRadical.comap q
  have hBRadical : B.IsRadical := by

      _ = Ideal.comap q (Ideal.radical ⊥) := rfl
      _ = Ideal.radical (Ideal.comap q ⊥) := Ideal.comap_radical q ⊥

    exact h
  exact
    ⟨A, B, hIA, hIB, hA, hB, hAmax, hBmax, hARadical, hBRadical,
      hABinf, hABradical⟩

statement:
theorem surjective_character_of_nonzero_reduction
    (χ : G →ₜ* Multiplicative (PadicInt p))
    (hχ : ∃ g : G, toZModPow 1 (χ g).toAdd ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective χ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hχ
  let f : G → PadicInt p := fun x => (χ x).toAdd
  have hf : Continuous f := χ.continuous
  have hunit : IsUnit (f g) := by
    by_contra h
    have hd : (p : PadicInt p) ∣ f g :=
      (norm_lt_one_iff_dvd (f g)).mp (not_isUnit_iff.mp h)
    apply hg
    change f g ∈ RingHom.ker (toZModPow 1)
    rw [ker_toZModPow, pow_one, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    exact hd
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hunit
  have hclosed : IsClosed (Set.range f) := (isCompact_range hf).isClosed
  have hmul (z : PadicInt p) : z * (u : PadicInt p) ∈ Set.range f := by
    refine DenseRange.induction_on denseRange_natCast z
      (hclosed.preimage (continuous_id.mul continuous_const)) ?_
    intro n
    rw [hu]
    refine ⟨g ^ n, ?_⟩
    change (χ (g ^ n)).toAdd = (n : PadicInt p) * f g
    rw [map_pow]
    change n • f g = (n : PadicInt p) * f g
    exact nsmul_eq_mul n (f g)
  intro y
  have hy := hmul (y.toAdd * (↑u⁻¹ : PadicInt p))
  rw [mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, mul_one] at hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hy
  exact ⟨x, congrArg Multiplicative.ofAdd hx⟩

theorem quotient_mk_mem_commutator_of_surjective_image_mem_commutator
    {N K : Type u} [Group N] [Group K]
    (f : N →* K) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (U : Subgroup N) [U.Normal] (hkerU : f.ker ≤ U)
    {n : N} (hn : f n ∈ commutator K) :
    QuotientGroup.mk' U n ∈ commutator (N ⧸ U)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm_le :
      commutator K ≤ (commutator N).map f := by
    rw [_root_.map_commutator_eq]
    have hrange : f.range = (⊤ : Subgroup K) := by
      ext k
      constructor
      · intro hk
        trivial
      · intro _hk
        rcases hf k with ⟨n, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨n, rfl⟩
    rw [hrange]
    exact Subgroup.commutator_mono (by intro x hx; trivial) (by intro x hx; trivial)
  rcases hcomm_le hn with ⟨c, hc, hcn⟩
  have hdiff : n * c⁻¹ ∈ U := by
    apply hkerU
    change f (n * c⁻¹) = 1
    rw [map_mul, map_inv, ← hcn, mul_inv_cancel]
  have hquot :
      QuotientGroup.mk' U n = QuotientGroup.mk' U c :=
    (QuotientGroup.eq_iff_div_mem (N := U)).2 (by
      simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using hdiff)
  have hcquot :
      QuotientGroup.mk' U c ∈ commutator (N ⧸ U) := by
    have hmap :
        (commutator N).map (QuotientGroup.mk' U) ≤
          commutator (N ⧸ U) := by
      rw [_root_.map_commutator_eq]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mono (by intro x hx; trivial) (by intro x hx; trivial)
    exact hmap ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
  simpa [hquot] using hcquot

    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [IsLocalRing C]
    {x : C} {a b : Ideal C}

  intro hx
  apply Ideal.inf_ne_bot_of_ne_bot haBot hbBot

/-- A group is torsion-free when every element of finite order is trivial. -/
def IsTorsionFreeGroup
    (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop :=
  ∀ g : G, IsOfFinOrder g → g = 1

/--
A topological group is slim when every open subgroup has trivial centralizer in the ambient
group.
-/
def IsSlim
    (G : Type u) [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] : Prop :=
  ∀ H : OpenSubgroup G, Subgroup.centralizer (H : Set G) = ⊥

/--
A topological group is slim modulo \(K\) when every open subgroup has centralizer contained in
\(K\).
-/
def IsSlimModulo
    (G : Type u) [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G]
    (K : Subgroup G) : Prop :=
  ∀ H : OpenSubgroup G, Subgroup.centralizer (H : Set G) ≤ K

/--
A continuous homomorphism is relatively slim when the image of every open subgroup has trivial
centralizer in the target.
-/
def IsRelativelySlim
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G]
    {H : Type v} [TopologicalSpace H] [Group H]
    (f : G →ₜ* H) : Prop :=
  ∀ U : OpenSubgroup G,
    Subgroup.centralizer ((((U : Subgroup G).map f.toMonoidHom : Subgroup H) : Set H)) = ⊥

/-- Relative slimness for the identity map is the same as slimness. -/

    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    [T0Space X] [QuasiSober Y] {f : X → Y} (hf : GeneralizingMap f)
    (x : genericPoints X) : f x.1 ∈ genericPoints Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [genericPoints]
  refine ⟨isIrreducible_singleton.closure, ?_⟩
  intro T hT hsub
  let y : Y := hT.genericPoint
  have hy : IsGenericPoint y (closure T) :=
    hT.isGenericPoint_genericPoint_closure
  have hfy : f x.1 ∈ closure {y} := by
    rw [hy.def]
    apply subset_closure
    exact hsub (subset_closure (Set.mem_singleton _))
  obtain ⟨z, hzx, hzy⟩ := hf (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hfy)
  have hclosure : closure {z} ⊆ closure {x.1} := by
    apply x.2.2 isIrreducible_singleton.closure
    exact closure_minimal
      (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp hzx))
      isClosed_closure
  have hxz : x.1 ∈ closure {z} := specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp hzx
  have hzx' : z ∈ closure {x.1} :=
    hclosure (subset_closure (Set.mem_singleton _))
  have hz : z = x.1 := Inseparable.eq <|
    inseparable_iff_specializes_and.mpr
      ⟨hzx, specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hzx'⟩
  have hyfx : y = f x.1 := by
    rw [← hzy, hz]
  calc
    T ⊆ closure T := subset_closure
    _ = closure {y} := hy.def.symm
    _ = closure {f x.1} := by rw [hyfx]

proof:
:= by
  let J : Ideal B := (RingHom.ker f.hom).map g.hom
  let q : B →+* B ⧸ J := Ideal.Quotient.mk J
  let lift : R ⧸ RingHom.ker f.hom →+* B ⧸ J :=
    Ideal.Quotient.lift (RingHom.ker f.hom) (q.comp g.hom) (by
      intro r hr
      apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem g.hom hr)
  let e : R ⧸ RingHom.ker f.hom ≃+* A :=
    RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hf
  let a : A →+* B ⧸ J := lift.comp e.symm.toRingHom
  have hcomm : f ≫ ofHom a = g ≫ ofHom q := by
    ext r
    change lift (e.symm (f.hom r)) = q (g.hom r)
    rw [RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective_symm_apply]
    rfl
  let d : P ⟶ of (B ⧸ J) := h.desc (ofHom a) (ofHom q) hcomm
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    change x ∈ J
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    change q x = 0
    have hd := congr($(h.inr_desc (ofHom a) (ofHom q) hcomm).hom x)
    simp only [hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, hom_ofHom] at hd
    rw [← hd]
    change d.hom (inr.hom x) = 0
    rw [show inr.hom x = 0 from hx]
    exact d.hom.map_zero
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro r hr
    change inr.hom (g.hom r) = 0
    have hw := congr($(h.w).hom r)
    simp only [hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at hw
    rw [← hw, show f.hom r = 0 from hr, map_zero]

        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim.symm

lemma RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_of_free_aux
    {R : Type u} {M : Type max u v} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Free R M] [Nontrivial M] {s : List R} :
      Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular M s ↔ Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular R s
proof:
:= by
  generalize hn : s.length = n
  induction n generalizing R M with
  | zero => simp_all
  | succ n IH =>
    cases s with
    | nil => exact (Nat.succ_ne_zero n hn.symm).elim
    | cons x xs =>
    let e : QuotSMulTop x R ≃ₗ[R] R ⧸ Ideal.span {x} := Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _
      (by rw [← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul, Ideal.smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top])
    let e' := QuotSMulTop.equivQuotTensor x M
    rw [Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff, Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff,
      e.isWeaklyRegular_congr, e'.isWeaklyRegular_congr,
      ← isWeaklyRegular_map_algebraMap_iff (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}),
      ← isWeaklyRegular_map_algebraMap_iff (R := R) (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})]

statement:
theorem irreducibleComponent_inter_subset_partition_side
    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (Z : Set X) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X)
    {U A B : Set X} (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B)
    (hcover : A ∪ B = U) (hdisjoint : Disjoint A B) :
    Z ∩ U ⊆ A ∨ Z ∩ U ⊆ B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hleft : Z ∩ U ⊆ A
  · exact Or.inl hleft
  · right
    obtain ⟨y, hyZU, hyA⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hleft
    have hyB : y ∈ B := by
      have hyAB : y ∈ A ∪ B := hcover.symm ▸ hyZU.2
      exact hyAB.resolve_left hyA
    intro z hzZU
    by_contra hzB
    have hzA : z ∈ A := by
      have hzAB : z ∈ A ∪ B := hcover.symm ▸ hzZU.2
      exact hzAB.resolve_right hzB
    obtain ⟨w, hwZ, hwAB⟩ :=
      hZ.1.2 A B hA hB ⟨z, hzZU.1, hzA⟩ ⟨y, hyZU.1, hyB⟩
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint hwAB.1 hwAB.2

statement:
theorem minimalPrime_quotient_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C)
    (Q : Ideal (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))
    (hQ : Q ∈ minimalPrimes (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    Q ≠ maximalIdeal (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := by
  let I : Ideal C := Ideal.span {x}
  let q : C →+* C ⧸ I := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  have hIle : I ≤ maximalIdeal C :=
    (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : Nontrivial (C ⧸ I) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top hIle
  let : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsLocalHom q :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hcomap : Q.comap q ∈ I.minimalPrimes := by
    have hQ' : Q ∈ (⊥ : Ideal (C ⧸ I)).minimalPrimes := hQ
    have := Ideal.minimalPrimes_comap_of_surjective
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective hQ'
    simpa only [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, q, Ideal.mk_ker] using this
  intro hQmax
  apply minimalPrime_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal hdim x (Q.comap q) hcomap
  rw [hQmax]
  exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap q

    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C)
    (Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})))
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:=

        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|

    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    (Z ∩ ({closedPoint (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})}ᶜ :
      Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})))).Nonempty := by
  let B := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let : Nontrivial B :=

      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|

  let : IsLocalRing B :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let Q : Ideal B := PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z
  have hQ : Q ∈ minimalPrimes B := by
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal_irreducibleComponents B]
    exact ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQ.isPrime
  let q : PrimeSpectrum B := ⟨Q, inferInstance⟩
  have hqZ : q ∈ Z := by
    have hclosed : IsClosed Z := isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z hZ

      rw [PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure,
        hclosed.closure_eq]
    rw [← hzero]
    exact show Q ≤ q.asIdeal from le_rfl
  have hqne : q ≠ closedPoint B := by
    intro hq
    apply minimalPrime_quotient_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal hdim x hx Q hQ

lemma isSMulRegular_X : IsSMulRegular R⟦X⟧ (X : R⟦X⟧) := by
  intro f g h

lemma ker_constantCoeff : RingHom.ker (constantCoeff (R := R)) = Ideal.span {(X : R⟦X⟧)} := by
  ext f
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, Ideal.mem_span_singleton, X_dvd_iff]

/-- Identify the power-series ring modulo its variable with the coefficient ring using the
constant coefficient. -/
def quotSpanXEquiv : (R⟦X⟧ ⧸ Ideal.span {(X : R⟦X⟧)}) ≃+* R :=
  (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq ker_constantCoeff.symm).trans
    (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective constantCoeff_surj)

lemma smul_top_eq_span_X :
    (X : R⟦X⟧) • (⊤ : Ideal R⟦X⟧) = Ideal.span {(X : R⟦X⟧)} := by
  rw [← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul, Ideal.smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]

coefficient ring. -/
def quotXSMulTopAddEquiv : QuotSMulTop (X : R⟦X⟧) R⟦X⟧ ≃+ R :=
  ((Ideal.quotEquivOfEq (R := R⟦X⟧) (smul_top_eq_span_X (R := R))).trans
    (quotSpanXEquiv (R := R))).toAddEquiv

@[scoped simp]
lemma quotXSMulTopAddEquiv_mk (f : R⟦X⟧) :
    quotXSMulTopAddEquiv (Submodule.Quotient.mk f) = constantCoeff f := by
  change quotSpanXEquiv ((Ideal.quotEquivOfEq smul_top_eq_span_X) (Submodule.Quotient.mk f)) =
    constantCoeff f
  simp only [Ideal.quotEquivOfEq]
  rfl

lemma quotXSMulTopAddEquiv_smul (r : R) (m : QuotSMulTop (X : R⟦X⟧) R⟦X⟧) :
    quotXSMulTopAddEquiv ((C r : R⟦X⟧) • m) = r • quotXSMulTopAddEquiv m := by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, quotXSMulTopAddEquiv_mk, quotXSMulTopAddEquiv_mk,
    smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, constantCoeff_C]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.irreducibleSpace_of_isPreimmersion_of_isDominant
statement:
theorem irreducibleSpace_of_isPreimmersion_of_isDominant
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X)
    [IsPreimmersion f] [IsDominant f] [IrreducibleSpace X] :
    IrreducibleSpace U
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty U := f.denseRange.nonempty
  let hpre : PreirreducibleSpace U :=
    PreirreducibleSpace.of_forall_nonempty_inter
      (fun {A B} hA hB hAne hBne ↦ by
        obtain ⟨A', hA'open, hA'⟩ :=
          f.isEmbedding.isInducing.isOpen_iff.mp hA
        obtain ⟨B', hB'open, hB'⟩ :=
          f.isEmbedding.isInducing.isOpen_iff.mp hB
        have hA'ne : A'.Nonempty := by
          obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hAne
          refine ⟨f a, ?_⟩
          change a ∈ f ⁻¹' A'
          rwa [hA']
        have hB'ne : B'.Nonempty := by
          obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hBne
          refine ⟨f b, ?_⟩
          change b ∈ f ⁻¹' B'
          rwa [hB']
        have hAB'ne : (A' ∩ B').Nonempty :=
          nonempty_preirreducible_inter hA'open hB'open hA'ne hB'ne
        obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ :=
          f.denseRange.exists_mem_open (hA'open.inter hB'open) hAB'ne
        refine ⟨a, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← hA']
          exact ha.1
        · rw [← hB']
          exact ha.2)
  exact { toPreirreducibleSpace := hpre, toNonempty := inferInstance }

name: Subgroup.map_topologicalClosure_eq_of_continuousMulEquiv
statement:
theorem map_topologicalClosure_eq_of_continuousMulEquiv
    {G H : Type*} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [TopologicalSpace H] [Group H] [IsTopologicalGroup H]
    (e : G ≃ₜ* H) (A : Subgroup G) :
    A.topologicalClosure.map e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom =
      (A.map e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom).topologicalClosure
proof:
:= by
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  calc
    ((A.topologicalClosure.map e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom : Subgroup H) : Set H) =
        e.toHomeomorph '' ((A.topologicalClosure : Subgroup G) : Set G) := by
          symm
          exact TopologicalGroup.image_subtype_eq_map
            (f := e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom) (K := A.topologicalClosure)
    _ = e.toHomeomorph '' (_root_.closure ((A : Subgroup G) : Set G)) := by
          rw [show ((A.topologicalClosure : Subgroup G) : Set G) =
              _root_.closure ((A : Set G)) by
            exact topologicalClosure_coe]
    _ = _root_.closure (e.toHomeomorph '' ((A : Subgroup G) : Set G)) := by
          exact e.toHomeomorph.image_closure ((A : Subgroup G) : Set G)
    _ = _root_.closure (((A.map e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom : Subgroup H) : Set H)) := by
          exact congrArg _root_.closure
            (TopologicalGroup.image_subtype_eq_map
              (f := e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom) (K := A))
    _ = (((A.map e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom).topologicalClosure : Subgroup H) : Set H) := by
          symm
          exact topologicalClosure_coe

theorem exists_finite_span_eq_maximalIdeal_mem [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {x : R} (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hx2 : x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2) :
    ∃ S : Set R, x ∈ S ∧ S.Finite ∧ S.ncard ≤ (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank ∧
      Ideal.span S = maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set ξ : CotangentSpace R := (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨x, hx⟩ with hξdef
  have hξ0 : ξ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hξdef, ne_eq, Ideal.toCotangent_eq_zero]
    exact hx2
  have hli : LinearIndepOn (ResidueField R) id ({ξ} : Set (CotangentSpace R)) := by
    refine LinearIndepOn.singleton' ?_
    intro r hr
    rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hr with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h hξ0
  obtain ⟨B, hξB, hBfin, hBcard, hBspan⟩ :
      ∃ B : Set (CotangentSpace R), ξ ∈ B ∧ B.Finite ∧
        B.ncard = (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank ∧
        Submodule.span (ResidueField R) B = ⊤ := by
    refine ⟨hli.extend (Set.subset_univ _),
      hli.subset_extend _ (Set.mem_singleton ξ), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have : Finite (hli.extend (Set.subset_univ ({ξ} : Set (CotangentSpace R)))) :=
        Module.Finite.finite_basis (Module.Basis.extend hli)
      exact Set.toFinite _
    · have : Finite (hli.extend (Set.subset_univ ({ξ} : Set (CotangentSpace R)))) :=
        Module.Finite.finite_basis (Module.Basis.extend hli)
      have : Fintype (hli.extend (Set.subset_univ ({ξ} : Set (CotangentSpace R)))) :=
        Fintype.ofFinite _
      rw [IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace R,
        Module.finrank_eq_card_basis (Module.Basis.extend hli),
        ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    · have h1 := (Module.Basis.extend hli).span_eq
      rwa [Module.Basis.range_extend] at h1
  choose lift hlift using (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent_surjective
  set S₀ : Set ↥(maximalIdeal R) := insert ⟨x, hx⟩ (lift '' (B \ {ξ})) with hS₀def
  have himg : (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent '' S₀ = B := by
    rw [hS₀def, Set.image_insert_eq, ← hξdef, ← Set.image_comp]
    have hcomp : ((maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ∘ lift) '' (B \ {ξ}) = B \ {ξ} := by
      have : ∀ v ∈ B \ {ξ}, ((maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ∘ lift) v = id v :=
        fun v _ => hlift v
      rw [Set.image_congr this, Set.image_id]
    rw [hcomp, Set.insert_sdiff_singleton, Set.insert_eq_self.mpr hξB]
  have hspanR : Submodule.span R S₀ = ⊤ := by
    apply IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff.mp
    rw [himg, hBspan]
  have hspan : Ideal.span ((↑) '' S₀ : Set R) = maximalIdeal R := by
    have hmap := congrArg (Submodule.map (maximalIdeal R).subtype) hspanR
    rwa [Submodule.map_span, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype] at hmap
  refine ⟨(↑) '' S₀, ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, by rw [hS₀def]; exact Set.mem_insert _ _, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_, hspan⟩
  · rw [hS₀def]
    exact (((hBfin.sdiff).image _).insert _).image _
  · have hfin₁ : (lift '' (B \ {ξ})).Finite := (hBfin.sdiff).image _
    have h1 : ((↑) '' S₀ : Set R).ncard ≤ S₀.ncard := by
      apply Set.ncard_image_le
      rw [hS₀def]; exact hfin₁.insert _
    have h2 : S₀.ncard ≤ (lift '' (B \ {ξ})).ncard + 1 := by
      rw [hS₀def]; exact Set.ncard_insert_le _ _
    have h3 : (lift '' (B \ {ξ})).ncard ≤ (B \ {ξ}).ncard :=
      Set.ncard_image_le hBfin.sdiff
    have h4 : (B \ {ξ}).ncard + 1 = B.ncard :=
      Set.ncard_sdiff_singleton_add_one hξB hBfin
    omega

    rintro ⟨I, hIs, hle⟩

theorem isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton_of_forall_notMem_minimalPrimes
    {x : R} (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hx2 : x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2)
    (hxmin : ∀ p ∈ minimalPrimes R, x ∉ p) [IsLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})] :
    IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ∧
      (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 =
        (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hxS, hSfin, hScard, hSspan⟩ :=
    exists_finite_span_eq_maximalIdeal_mem R hx hx2
  have hmax' : (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) =
      maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
    IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hmkx : (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) x = 0 := by
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
  have hmap : (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) =
      Ideal.span ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) '' (S \ {x})) := by
    rw [← hSspan, Ideal.map_span]
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      by_cases hyx : y = x
      · subst hyx
        rw [SetLike.mem_coe, hmkx]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨y, ⟨hy, hyx⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact Ideal.span_mono (Set.image_mono Set.sdiff_subset)
  have hsf_le : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 ≤
      (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank := by
    have h1 : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank ≤ (S \ {x}).ncard := by
      rw [← hmax', hmap]
      exact le_trans
        (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite ((hSfin.sdiff).image _))
        (Set.ncard_image_le hSfin.sdiff)
    have h2 : (S \ {x}).ncard + 1 = S.ncard :=
      Set.ncard_sdiff_singleton_add_one hxS hSfin
    omega
  have hkrull : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ≤
